data.summary:
Business Execution professional with 9+ years in financial services, specializing in regulatory reporting (EMIR, MiFID II, CASS), payments, and FX/treasury settlements across capital markets. Proven track record leading EMIR trade and collateral reporting, MiFID II transaction reporting, and cross-jurisdiction back-reporting on Colline, while driving ISO 20022 (MX) migration and SWIFT messaging (MT202, MT303, MT900/910, MT940/950, MT540, MT599) standards adoption. Delivered $1.4M in cost savings and 2,600+ hours saved annually through Alteryx automation, with hands-on expertise executing FX spot settlements, clearing payment exceptions within strict cut-off windows, and leading teams through client account transfers, cash payments, and funding across the full trade and payment lifecycle.
AREAS OF EXPERTISE
Regulatory Reporting • Lead EMIR trade and collateral reporting, MiFID II transaction reporting, and cross-jurisdiction back-reporting, validating data
quality to meet regulatory deadlines and audit standards.
Perform CASS client money and custody asset reconciliations, and maintain CASS, REMS, and RCSA operational risk frameworks to prevent AML/ASL breaches.
Partner with Technology, Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to investigate and remediate reporting breaks across Colline and downstream regulatory reporting platforms.
Payments • Lead a team accountable for client account transfers, cash payments, and funding across the full trade and payment lifecycle for
a high-volume securities function.
Own workflow tracking, queue management, and exception management, resolving escalated, time-sensitive payment issues against strict cut-off timelines.
Delivered daily overdraft (OD) position reporting on client accounts, ensuring SLA/KRI payment commitments were met, and reported $1M+ overdraft positions across APAC.
ISO 20022 & SWIFT Messaging • Drove ISO 20022 (MX) adoption initiatives alongside Alteryx automation, saving 2,600+ hours annually and improving
nostro/trade reconciliation accuracy.
Completed internal training on ISO 20022 (MX) Messaging Standards and SWIFT Payment Processing at JP Morgan Chase & Co. • Working knowledge of SWIFT MT202, MT303, MT900/910, MT940/950, MT540, and MT599 message types across payment, treasury, and settlement workflows.
FX & Treasury • Executed FX settlements — buying and selling currencies at spot rate per client instructions — within currency cut-off windows,
clearing cash exceptions on TLM and ELM.
Funded corporate action events and corrected client books through FX adjustments arising from internal or market-driven settlement errors.
Use Colline for Initial Margin (IM) and Variation Margin (VM) collateral management, supporting regulatory reporting aligned with EMIR margin and collateral obligations.
Institutional Client Onboarding • Coordinate across Front Office, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Credit, Documentation, Collateral, and Client Account teams to
ensure all prerequisites are completed prior to trading commencement.
Track KYC/AML documentation, credit approvals, and account set-up requirements end-to-end, escalating outstanding items to keep onboarding timelines on track.
Act as the central point of contact between internal stakeholders and clients, resolving onboarding blockers to accelerate account activation and trade readiness.
